name: Chunkurchak Gorge
near: The tract/village of Chunkurchak (the complex's address in 2GIS); approaches — from Kashka-Suu (the Ala-Archa side) and from Arashan (the Alamedin side). Tatyr is ~6.6 km as the crow flies from the former catalog point (OSM).
elev: The ski complex — 2060–2220 m (Nomad's Land, 2024–25 season); the “Sky Bridge” — about 2400 m, the meadows — from ~2000 m (asiamixtravel); Kyzyl-Beles Pass — about 2300 m (too.kg).
short: Chunkurchak is the nearest high-mountain gorge to Bishkek (~30–45 km): a ski complex, the suspension “Sky Bridge”, the Supara ethno-resort, the Dove Waterfall and the red slopes of Kyzyl-Beles.
desc: Chunkurchak stretches along the northern slope of the Kyrgyz Ala-Too between the Ala-Archa and Alamedin gorges; it is about 30 km long (too.kg). The landscape is sharp snow-capped peaks, flowery meadows, sparse spruce forests and the red soils near Kyzyl-Beles Pass (~2300 m). The main centre is the Chunkurchak ski complex (2060–2220 m, 5 chairlifts, >10 km of runs per sxodim) and the Supara Chunkurchak ethno-resort; in summer a cable car operates to the suspension “Sky Bridge” (~125 m, ~2400 m, opened in 2021), along with horse rides and an archery range. From the complex it is a short walk to the 30 m Dove Waterfall. In 2025–2026 the Arashan — Chunkurchak road (20.7 km) was rebuilt: by 29.07.2026 the first layer of asphalt had been laid along its entire length and two bridges had been built.
guide: Chunkurchak is the simplest way to find yourself at 2000+ m within an hour of Bishkek. Take the cable car up to the “Sky Bridge” — the 125 m suspension bridge over the gorge gives the best panorama of the snowy peaks. Then walk down to the 30 m Dove Waterfall (20–30 minutes on foot) and have lunch in the Supara yurts. If you like wild views, drive (better in a 4×4) to the red slopes of Kyzyl-Beles Pass. With the new paved road from Arashan you can make a loop Alamedin — Chunkurchak — Ala-Archa in one day.
see: The “Sky Bridge” (suspension, ~125 m, ~2400 m) and the cable car; the Dove Waterfall (~30 m); the Supara Chunkurchak ethno-resort; the red slopes and Kyzyl-Beles Pass (~2300 m); spruce forests and flowering meadows; tulips from late April to mid-May (asiamixtravel).
skip: You are looking for deserted mountains — Chunkurchak is heavily developed (a resort, a cable car, restaurants) and crowded on weekends. You want serious trekking — Ala-Archa or Kegety are better. You dislike paid entertainment — most activities (the cable car, the bridge, horses) cost money.
diff: Easy: the main points are accessible by car and cable car; the walk to the Dove Waterfall is 20–30 min (asiamixtravel); meadow walks 2–3 h. The upper section via Kyzyl-Beles is off-road for a prepared 4×4 (too.kg).
when: June — early September — meadows and hikes; late April — mid-May — tulips (asiamixtravel). The ski season is December — April (Nomad's Land; asiamixtravel — mid-December — March). In winter you need studded tires.
hours: The ski complex: 10:00–16:00 daily (sxodim, Nomad's Land); summer activities — in daylight, the cable car's hours are not confirmed. The gorge is open 24 hours. Complex phone +996 558 586 898, info@chunkurchak.kg.
daytime: Weekday mornings: shorter queues for the cable car and clear views of the peaks; in summer there are often clouds after lunch. Sunset at the bridge — depends on the weather (editorial).
how: From Bishkek ~30–45 km, about 1 h by car. Two approaches: from the west via Kashka-Suu (the Ala-Archa side) and from the east via Arashan (the Alamedin Gorge) — the 20.7 km Arashan — Chunkurchak road was paved in 2026 (Kaktus.media 29.07.2026). There is no direct public transport: a taxi or marshrutka (minibus) to Arashan/Kashka-Suu + a local taxi.
needcar: Yes: a car, taxi or transfer — there is no direct public transport to the complex (too.kg, asiamixtravel).
self: Yes, by car or taxi; everything on site (cable car, cafe, rental) works without a guide. Without a car you will have to combine a marshrutka (minibus) and a taxi.
roadtype: Paved to the complex: from the Arashan side — the new 20.7 km road (the first layer of asphalt along its entire length by 29.07.2026, the second layer was being laid); from the Kashka-Suu side — paved. The upper section via Kyzyl-Beles is dirt, off-road for 4×4 (too.kg).
traveltime: Bishkek → complex ≈1 h by car (asiamixtravel); the Dove Waterfall — 20–30 min on foot; the climb to the bridge — by cable car or 20–30 min on foot.
stay: The Supara Chunkurchak ethno-resort (yurts and wooden cabins, 2GIS: 4.9/5, 2207 ratings, rooms from 7,500 som); hotel rooms at the Chunkurchak ski complex; a few more recreation bases (too.kg mentions four ski bases, and in summer — rest houses and kumis-therapy clinics).
net: Beeline and O! work at the complex, the signal weakens on the upper meadows (asiamixtravel, 2026).
entry: A separate fee for entering the gorge, per asiamixtravel, is under $1 per person (not officially confirmed). Paid services: the winter ski pass 1,500 som adult / 1,100 child (2024–25 season, Nomad's Land); the summer cable car and “Sky Bridge” are paid, the amount is not confirmed.
transfer: A taxi ~$12–18 one way (2026); a complex transfer 3,200–4,350 som (2024–25); an excursion $100–140 per group (Sputnik8), €100 (Tripster).
bring: A windbreaker and a warm layer (2000–2400 m, 8–10 °C cooler than Bishkek), sun protection, comfortable shoes for the descent to the waterfall, cash (cards are accepted only at the main venues — asiamixtravel). In winter — studded tires for the car.
warn: The upper road via Kyzyl-Beles is off-road, only a prepared 4×4 and an experienced driver (too.kg). In winter — black ice, studs are mandatory. The cable car and bridge are commercial attractions: check whether they are operating on the day of your trip. On the new paved Arashan — Chunkurchak road work was still going on in 2026 (barriers, markings).
food: Lunch at the Supara Chunkurchak ethno-resort — Kyrgyz cuisine in yurts (a full lunch $10–18 — asiamixtravel; the average check of the Supara restaurant in Bishkek is 1,700 som, 2GIS); a fast-food cafe at the ski complex (average check 1,200 som — sxodim); in summer — kumis at the bases.
reviews: 2GIS: the Chunkurchak ski complex — 4.9/5, 3515 ratings; Supara Chunkurchak — 4.9/5, 2207 ratings (07.10.2026). Google has no unambiguous listing for the gorge. Sputnik8 “Sky Bridge” — 5.0, 9 reviews. Pros: close to Bishkek, views from the bridge, good infrastructure. Cons: crowded and commercialized, everything is paid.
p.sum: Chunkurchak is the nearest “high-mountain” gorge to Bishkek (2000–2400 m) with a cable car, the “Sky Bridge”, horse rides and the Supara ethno-resort. The easiest way is by Yandex Go/inDrive taxi (≈1 h, ≈$12–18) or with an excursion. There is no direct marshrutka (minibus): you can take marshrutka No. 265 to Kashka-Suu and change to a local taxi. Since summer 2026 a new paved road from Arashan (20.7 km) also leads to the gorge. On site, per Datka Travel prices: the “Sky Bridge” ≈$6, the cable car or zipline $3–5, a horse ≈$12/hour. A night at Supara — from $73.

p.iti.2.title: What to combine
p.iti.2.plan: Ala-Archa National Park (via Kashka-Suu, ≈30–40 min), the Alamedin Gorge and the Alamedin hot springs (via Arashan), the Kara-Bulak gorge
p.season: Late April — mid-May: tulips. June — early September: green meadows, horse rides, the bridge, crowded on weekends; ticks in spring and early summer. September — October: golden autumn. December — March/April: ski season, 10:00–16:00, studs needed
p.budget.economy: ≈1,500–3,000 som: marshrutka (minibus) No. 265 + a local taxi ≈400–500 som round trip, the bridge ≈$6, the cable car $3–5, a horse for 1 h ≈$12, a snack
p.budget.comfort: ≈$100–200 per person or group: a taxi or tour (Sputnik8 $100–140 per group; Datka $144/person), lunch at Supara $10–18, a night at Supara from $73
p.permits: No permits needed. Per asiamixtravel a symbolic fee (<$1) may be charged at the gorge entrance; not officially confirmed
p.access: One of the most accessible mountain outings: paved to the complex, a lift, easy walks — suitable for children and older people. With a stroller — the Supara territory and the complex's cafe, but not the waterfall and bridge. Altitude 2000–2400 m, cool. Dogs: no rules found
